svg.aria-label: Notebook sketch of ULTRON, a personal AI that runs on my laptop: 19 processes, 337 tests. Four Rust processes (input hooks, insight pulse, memory engine, ghost, encrypted LAN sync) and fifteen Python ones (voice, LLM router, tools and agents, privacy router and ten more) share one WebSocket bus that needs a token. If one crashes, the rest keep going. Every event goes into a hash-chained log that rejects edits and deletes. The privacy router sends a cloud model only text with names, paths and secrets stripped; money, health and files never leave.

one WebSocket bus: every process signs in with a token
every event goes into a hash-chained log

g.text: it answers from what it saw today
